research_question: How should a project restore its original/proxy association without silently choosing different media, preserving unaffected producers? The restore/collision cases below are research-authored, not #910 reproduction claims.

conditions.provenance: existing code contract + research preservation condition
conditions.text: Retain original resource while proxy is active and restore the same intended source when proxy is disabled or project saved/reopened.
A same-name candidate with different intended media must not silently replace the missing source or alter an unrelated producer.

interface: ProxyManager::resource reads shotcut:resource for proxy-backed producer. MltXmlChecker::checkForProxy substitutes hash-named proxy and retains original. ProxyManager::filterXML/processProperties restores original in normal saved XML. UnlinkedFilesDialog::lookInDir offers matching hash OR matching filename, with warning on filename-only mismatch. Util::getHash caches shotcut:hash; getFileHash uses file size plus first and last 1 MB for files >2 MB. fixUnlinkedFile updates resource/hash/caption. Pending proxy generation then post-job rename/replace are distinct writes. No runtime outcomes provided.
